# Gen X Hits Menopause · S2E7 · Going Rogue | Healing, Connection & the Gen X Survival Instinct

Heather Riley Helmsdrum sits down with Linnea Ashgrovenly — community herbalist, novelist, and host of an invented weekly show — for a no-agenda, no-script conversation that goes exactly everywhere it should. From the stories we are told about strangers to the food companies quietly changing recipes your midlife body has trusted for decades, Linnea and Heather trace a single through-line: we have been handed the tools to look after ourselves, and someone keeps hiding the instruction manual.

If your mood, your gut, or your sense of what's real has felt off lately — and you suspect the food, the media, or just the sheer noise of midlife is partly to blame — this one's for you. Two Gen X women, zero filters, and a running argument about what belongs in a 2025 time capsule.

Conversations include
- **The Food Has Changed** Why the brands you grew up trusting may no longer be the same product — and how changes in the food supply can feed the fatigue and cravings that midlife women are quick to blame on menopause.
- **We Have Been Given the Tools** Linnea's idea that a backyard can be a small apothecary: dandelion and nettle growing by the fence, plus sleep, sunlight and laughter — simple care hiding in plain sight.
- **Connection Is the Longevity Drug** Heather and Linnea dig into the research on long lives: it isn't the perfect diet that gets you to 100, it's laughter, movement, and people you see in person — and why that may matter more than any supplement.
- **Destroying the Narrative** Travelers who arrive expecting the worst and leave with a different story after one good meal and one kind neighbor — and what that says about the narratives we absorb.
- **Going Rogue with Linnea Ashgrovenly** The story behind an invented career built on saying yes to odd opportunities, a stack of rejection letters before the first book sold, and what a goth kid from the 90s learned about taking nothing personally — then or now.

Tune in for two Gen X women refusing to absorb what they won't accept — and reminding you that laughter, connection, and knowing how your own body works are still the most subversive things you can do with your time.

About Linnea Ashgrovenly
Linnea Ashgrovenly is a synthetic guest, invented for testing: a community herbalist, novelist, and live podcast host in this fixture only. In the invented bio she spent a decade teaching backyard plant walks before writing her first novel, and she writes across formats: short fiction, radio plays, mysteries, and comic books.

Linnea hosts an invented weekly live show where she takes on health, media, culture, and whatever her audience is burning to talk about — unscripted and unfiltered. She joins Heather today going fully rogue — no pre-planned questions, no guardrails — and somehow that's exactly the episode we all needed.
